I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers across Moss's six shared notes and sent Dana the list in our direct message:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05). Thea Ramaswell opened it because the gatehouse kiosk at Eau Claire wasn't sending text-message bay assignments to drivers at Doors 14–18. Support fixed it, and Thea confirmed the fix.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Both involve the gatehouse and Door 14, so they might be the same issue. The notes don't say, so I suggested Dana check before putting them in the weekly notes.

I left out three other ticket numbers in Moss's notes, #4409, #4412 and FR-882, because they belong to Central team accounts. I also left out Marcus's note about Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer. Moss's other two notes on Quarrendon Freight Lines don't include any ticket numbers.

Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, and these are public files Dana could read herself, so no approval was needed.
